$comment: Structural budgets for the feed row-cost harness (issue #1103). Exact counts, not timings: they are deterministic, so they can gate CI. Lower a ceiling when an optimization lands; raising one is a decision to write down in the PR. Bloom 7.31 + react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0 (inline video on iPhone Safari): text hostNodes 52.125 -> 53.125 because Bloom 7.9.2 gives the avatar placeholder image its own positioned wrapper so it paints above the absolute shape fill on web; linkPreview contextReads 53 -> 55 because react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0 re-runs an interop component's rule effect after commit (its StrictMode-safe subscription), so the link card's interop Pressable reads its two CSS contexts twice on mount. Bloom 10.7.0 (Alia's live avatar on the Ask Alia button): linkPreview contextReads 55 -> 56 because Bloom's Avatar now also calls useMessages(AGENT_AVATAR_MESSAGES) for its character-face label, a second LocaleContext read on every Avatar even when it draws no character (every avatar row gains one; only linkPreview had no headroom). Bloom can read that catalog only in the character branch and give this back. Bloom 11.1.0: text componentsPerRow 195 -> 196. Comparing the real text-row fiber trees on main 319ab1dd6 and the update (eight rows), each native Image becomes BloomImage + ExpoImage: +1 component per row, with no extra host nodes or requests. Every other ceiling is unchanged. Bloom inline post Markdown: comparing main a686b2525 (Bloom 12.2.0) against the real shared InlineMarkdown renderer adds one component, one theme context read and one hook per post body; quote rows render two bodies. Host nodes, requests and unrelated-row renders are unchanged. Raise only exhausted component ceilings: text 196 -> 197 and quote 266 -> 268. Other ceilings retain their existing headroom.
